faqs.question: Why is this oil control face wash soap-free?
faqs.answer: Soap-free cleansers are suitable for sensitive skin and keep your skin away from irritation. Another fantastic benefit of soap-free face cleansers is that they do not over dry your skin.

faqs.question: My skin type is dry, can I use this 1% Salicylic Acid Face Wash (Foam-Based) for women?
faqs.answer: We recommend using a hydrating cleanser as the active ingredients in the 1% Salicylic Acid Face Wash (Foam-Based) may cause minor dryness.

faqs.question: Is this an SLS and Paraben-free face wash for women?
faqs.answer: We promise to keep all harmful chemicals at bay from our products. Hence, this foaming face wash is SLS, Paraben and soap-free.

faqs.question: Are there any side effects of this Face Wash containing salicylic acid and glycolic acid?
faqs.answer: This facewash may cause minor dryness. Reduce usage to once daily if excessive dryness or peeling occurs. Do not use with retinol based products.
